stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    for r in range(H):

    out=A.copy()
    # components (4-conn) over cells whose color != any sep color, on original grid
    seen=np.zeros_like(A,bool)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if A[r,c]==0 or (r in sepv or c in sepc) or seen[r,c]: continue
            col=A[r,c]; comp=[]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r,c]=True
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx

            rs=[a for a,b in comp]; cs=[b for a,b in comp]

            cands=[]
            for sep_idx,ax in [(sepc.index(s) if False else None,None)]: pass
            # vertical seps (columns): horizontal mirror

                else: continue
                tgt={(y, 2*s-x) for y,x in comp if 0<=2*s-x<W}
                if any(not(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W) or out[y,x]!=0 or (y,x) in set(comp) for y,x in tgt): continue
                if not all(out[y,x]==0 for y,x in tgt-set(comp)): continue
                cands.append(('h',s,tgt))
            for s in [s for s in list(sepc)]: pass
            # horizontal seps (rows): vertical mirror
            sr=[s for s in range(H) if s in sepv]
            for s in sr:
                if s<rmin or s>rmax: continue

                # ensure adjacency-ish: use any s where mirror fits disjoint
                tgt={(2*s-y,x) for y,x in comp}
                if any(not(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W) or out[y,x]!=0 or (y,x) in set(comp) for y,x in tgt): continue

            adj=[t for t in cands if abs(t[1]-rmin)<=1 and abs(t[1]-cmin)<=1 or True]
            # simpler: keep only candidates whose sep is adjacent to shape (within 1 of bbox edge on the axis of travel)
            def touching(s,axis):

                _,s,tgt=ch[0]
            for y,x in tgt-set(comp): out[y,x]=col
    return out.tolist()
